findings.reason: Intentional single-host HTTP ingress and explicit /32 management allowlist. A public IP is necessary for this reference without a billable load balancer/NAT. No backend ports. Not a private-only production workload.
No deployment; no flow-log sink or recurring logging cost. Reassess logging/retention before production. Existing free host/application monitoring is the reference boundary.
Use provider-managed encryption at rest. Customer-managed keys add IAM, lifecycle and potential cost obligations not justified for public static-content reference. Reassess for sensitive data.

policy: All findings remain visible. Unreviewed findings or expired review fail CI; accepted design risks do not mean scanner-clean.
